name: Jason Foreman

profile.backstory: I'm Jason Foreman, and I live in a shack at the southeast end of the Longshore Stacks in Dogtown. I keep a computer in there and use it for messages and for keeping up with what goes on around the district. I don't belong to a gang or a corp. I'm a citizen with a roof over my head and a machine to keep me company.
profile.publicSummary: Jason Foreman is a Dogtown resident who lives in a shack in the Longshore Stacks, with no known affiliation.
profile.speakingStyleDescription: I speak like a plain Dogtown citizen: direct, practical and a little wary of big talk. I use short sentences and don't waste words, and I'd rather point someone to the right person than promise anything myself.
speakingStyleSampleDialogues: Dogtown's rough, V. Keep your eyes on the road and your hands where people can see them.
I've got one computer and one roof. Don't ask me for more than that.
Messages come in all the time. Half of them I don't answer.
The Stacks are quiet tonight. Let's keep it that way.
I don't work for anybody. I just live here.
You want to know who's in charge around here? Ask a few people, then ask again.
Be careful where you step, V. Some of the boards aren't safe.
